map.对建筑火灾风险进行多因素量化打分，输出综合风险等级与整改建议: Quantitatively score building fire risk across multiple factors and output an overall risk level with rectification recommendations.
map.火灾风险分 = 建筑类型分 + 高度分 + 面积分 + 人员密度分 − 消防设施: Fire risk score = building-type score + height score + area score + occupancy-density score − facility reduction; the total maps to a risk level, with a higher score meaning higher risk.
map.基础风险分 = 建筑类型分 + 高度分 + 面积分 + 人员密度分（0~100）: Base risk score = building-type score + height score + area score + occupancy-density score (0-100)
map.设施减免分 = 每具备一项消防设施减免一定分值: Facility reduction = a certain score deducted for each fire facility present
map.危险因素加分 = 每存在一项危险因素增加一定分值: Hazard addition = a certain score added for each hazard factor present
map.综合风险分 = 基础风险分 - 设施减免分 + 危险因素加分: Overall risk score = base risk score - facility reduction + hazard addition
map.低风险：0~30 | 中风险：31~60 | 高风险：61~85 | 极高风险：: Low risk: 0-30 | Moderate risk: 31-60 | High risk: 61-85 | Extremely high risk: 86-100+
map.本工具为工程估算模型，正式评估应依据《建筑火灾风险评估标准》及当地消防法规执行。: This tool is an engineering estimation model; a formal assessment should follow the Building Fire Risk Assessment Standard and local fire codes.

map.消防检查后输出整改优先级，指导资金与人力投放顺序。: After a fire-safety inspection, output rectification priorities to guide the order of funding and manpower allocation.
map.保险或第三方评估时作为风险等级的快速初判工具。: Serve as a quick preliminary risk-level tool for insurance or third-party assessment.

Rectification recommendations include adding an automatic sprinkler system, installing an automatic fire alarm system and adding a mechanical smoke-exhaust system. The lower the score the safer; moderate risk means some hazards exist and daily patrols and facility maintenance must be strengthened.

map.设施减免项怎么体现？: How is the facility reduction reflected?
map.已配置自动报警、自动灭火、机械排烟等主动设施会按比例扣减基础分；存在易燃易爆品、: Active facilities already provided, such as automatic alarm, automatic extinguishing and mechanical smoke exhaust, deduct from the base score proportionally; hazardous items such as flammable/explosive materials and large crowds add score, embodying the principle of 'deduct for facilities, add for hazard sources'.
